verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਮਿਠਾਈ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਛੁਪਾਇ ਜਤਨ ਕੈ ਚੀਟੀ ਚਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਚੀਨਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau miThaiee raakheeaai chhupai jatan kai cheeTee chal jai cheen taeh lapaTaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as sweetmeats are hidden carefully and yet ants reach it with impunity and cling to them,

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੀਪਕ ਜਗਾਇ ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਦੁਰਾਇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪਤੰਗ ਤਾ ਮੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dheepak jagai jaise raakheeaai dhurai gireh pragaT pata(n)g taa mai sahaj samaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a lit lamp is carefully hidden in the house, yet a moth is able to find it and merges in its flame,

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਬਿਮਲ ਜਲ ਕਮਲ ਇਕਾਂਤ ਬਸੈ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਮਧੁ ਅਚਵਨ ਤਹ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau bimal jal kamal ikaa(n)t basai madhukar madh achavan teh jaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as the lotus flower of fresh and clean water blooms in solitary place, but the black bee always reaches it to enjoy its elixir,

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਕਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਤਿਹਿ ਦੁਆਰ ਬਿਲਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੪੧੦॥
verses.translit_en: taise gurmukh jeh ghaT pragaTat prem sakal sa(n)saar teh dhuaar bilalaat hai ||410||

en.bdb: So does a devoted disciple of the True Guru whose heart is kindled with the Love of the Lord, the whole world beseeches and whines at his door.  (410)
